questions.q: (a) Anurag is eclipsed by his wife, /(b) who is cleverer and /(c) amusing than he is. /(d) No error
In the following sentence the underlined part contains as error. Alternatives to the underlined part are given as options. Select the correct alternative.
questions.s:
Correct Answer:true

Explanation:

  • The sentence is: "He is truest to his words."

  • The error lies in the use of "truest", which is a superlative form.

  • In this context, we’re not comparing him with others but simply describing his quality of being faithful or loyal.

  • The correct word should be "true" (adjective), as in:

  • ✅ "He is true to his words."

Let’s eliminate the other options:

  • Most truly – adverbial; doesn't fit the structure.

  • Truer – comparative; not suitable here.

  • Truly – adverb; would modify a verb, not correct here.

Therefore, the correct replacement is true.

questions.q: Select the grammatically correct sentence. (SSC CGL TIER-01 17/07/23)
o: The Supriya is a best girl in the class.
The Supriya is the best girl in the class.
Supriya is the best girl in the class.
Supriya is best girl in the class.
questions.s: Proper nouns don't take 'The'. Superlative 'best' requires 'the'.

questions.q: Can we rely (a)/on this agency (b)/for the last news (c)/of the day. (d)
The Railways have made (1)/ crossing the tracks (2)/ a punished offence. (3)/ No error (4).
questions.s: Replace “punished” with “punishable”.

questions.q: The five first girls/will get the discount/on our merchandise. (SSC CHSL Tier-01 14/03/23)
questions.s: The correct order for multiple adjectives is ordinal before cardinal: "the first five girls".

questions.q: The view is (a) / very much beautiful (b) / from here. (c) / No error (d)
questions.s: The error is in part (b). 'Much' is redundant; correct form is 'very beautiful.' Answer: (b). 'Much' extra hai, sahi form hai 'very beautiful.' Jawab: (b).

questions.q: Ramesh is smarter (a) / enough to get (b) / selected for this (c) / post, without any recommendations. (d) / No error (e)
questions.s: It should be "smart enough", not "smarter enough".

questions.q: On a holiday (a) / Madhu prefers reading (b) / than going to the cinema. (c) / no error (d)
questions.s: After "prefers" use "to".

questions.q: The author is not well known. Little bit people have heard of him.
questions.s:
(d) Few people

Explanation:- ' Little bit of ' and 'a little bit of ' ka use uncountable nouns ke liye hota hai jabki people countable noun hai. Sentence ke shuru me likha hai ki 'Author well known nhi hai' isliye aage ' Few people' (na ke brabar log)' ka use hoga.

questions.q: Bose is (a) / more popular than (b) / any other student in the class. (c) / No error (d)
questions.s: There is no error. 'More popular than any other' is correct for comparative degree. Answer: (d). Sentence mein koi galti nahi, 'more popular than any other' comparative ke liye sahi hai. Jawab: (d).

questions.q: This is (a) / a most difficult (b) / problem to solve. (c) / No error (d)
questions.s: The error is in part (b). 'Most difficult' should be 'very difficult' as 'most' is superlative, not needed here. Answer: (b). 'Most difficult' ke bajay 'very difficult' sahi hai kyunki 'most' superlative hai. Jawab: (b).

questions.q: India have a many all-rounders to match the talent and dedication of Kapil Dev.
questions.s: (d) Explanation:- 'a many ' sath nhi aa sakte isliye B option nhi hoga. Have ki ing form possession ke case use nhi hoti isliye A option nhi hoga. Much adjective uncountable ke liye aata hai isliye C nhi hoga. Isliye grammar and meaning ke according D option hi sahi hai.

questions.q: He walked more faster (a)/ as he could so that (b)/ he would not (c)/ miss the train to work. (d)/ No error (e)
questions.s: Double comparative error. Use simply "He walked faster" - remove "more" before "faster.”

questions.q: Using a loofah with a hydrating / shower gel each day also ensures / you'll have the most smoothest skin. (SSC MTS Tier-01 09/05/23)
o: Shower gel each day also ensures
You'll have the most smoothest skin.
Using a loofah with a hydrating
questions.s: 'Most smoothest' is a double superlative. 'Smoothest' is already the superlative form.

questions.q:
In the following sentence the underlined part contains an error. Alternatives to the underlined part are given as options.

Select the correct alternative.

The new almirah is big than this one.
questions.s:
The comparative form of "big" is "bigger," used here to compare two almirahs.

More big: Incorrect, as "bigger" is the standard form.

Biggest: Superlative, used for more than two items.

More bigger: Redundant and incorrect.

The correct sentence: The new almirah is bigger than this one.

Hence, the correct answer is option (a)

questions.q: The rate of metabolism of (a) / a body is comparatively lowest when (b) / it is at rest and is thus, optimum for examination. (d) / no error (e)
o: a body is comparatively lowest when
it is at rest and is thus, optimum for examination.
questions.s: Use "comparatively low" or "the lowest", not "comparatively lowest".

questions.q: Don’t worry, there is less time for the train to arrive.
questions.s:
Explanation:- yahan koi comparison nahi ho rha isliye 'less' ka use nahi hoga. inme se koi bhi word laga sakte hain.

some time (thoda time)

enough time (Paryapt time)

a little time (thoda time)

Note:- yahan 'few' ki jagah 'little' ka use nahi ho sakta kyunki sentence ke shuru me 'don't worry' likha hai jisse pta chal raha hai ki hum aage positive meaning dena chahte hain. 'little' laga dene se meaning ho jayega ki 'na ke barabar time bacha hai'.

questions.q: My friend has started a restaurant in a wooden big building in Manali.
questions.s:
Again adjective order rule:
Size → Colour → Material → Noun
Size must come before material.
Correct order: in a big wooden building

questions.q:
Prashant is better from more other players of our school.

[CGL Mains- 28/01/2022]
questions.s: The correct preposition for comparison is "than", not "from." Also, "most other" is used to compare within a group.

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of the superlative degree of an adjective?
questions.s: The superlative degree of the adjective 'far' is 'farthest'. Hence, (d) is the correct answer.

questions.q: She runs (a) / more faster (b) / than her friend. (c) / No error (d)
questions.s: The error is in part (b). 'Faster' is already comparative; 'more' is redundant. Correct form is 'faster than.' Answer: (b). 'Faster' pehle se comparative hai, 'more' extra hai. Sahi form hai 'faster than.' Jawab: (b).

questions.q: The apple tree was loaded of fruit.
questions.s: (d) Explanation:- Trees pe lage fruits ke liye and person pe emotion burden ya responsibilities etc ke liye loaded nhi laden ka use hota hai. isliye yhan 'Laden with' ka use hoga.

questions.q:
To descend a cragged / mountain, however, was most/ difficult and dangerous / than to ascend it.

[MTS-11/07/2022 S1]
questions.s: The sentence needs "more difficult and dangerous" instead of "most difficult and dangerous" to compare the two actions.
